# NEW 2026-11-18 after the Restoration of Rome. Generated by gen_after_restoration.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_ar_add_strain = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_ar_strain add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ar_strain min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# BYZ scope. An exarchate: a theme seated at $seat$ (or the most populous eligible place of the region) whose
# jurisdiction is every imperial location of the region not yet in a theme. Same founding steps as
# oe_theme_found_at_seat (gen_theme_setup.py), with a region-wide jurisdiction.
oe_ar_found_exarchate = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:$seat$ = { owner = c:BYZ NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system } } }
        location:$seat$ = { save_scope_as = oe_ar_seat }
    }
    else = {
        ordered_owned_location = { limit = { $region$ = yes NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system } } order_by = population save_scope_as = oe_ar_seat }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_ar_seat }
        scope:oe_ar_seat = {
            create_building_country_in_location = {
                religion = religion:orthodox
                culture = culture:oe_roman_noble_culture
                subject_type = subject_type:$type$
                overlord = c:BYZ
                reforms = { oe_byz_theme_system_subject }
                hidden_effect = {
                    change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
                    change_heir_selection = heir_selection:oe_rome_province_elect
                }
                save_scope_as = oe_ar_exarch_country
            }
            construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system_noble owner = scope:oe_ar_exarch_country cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
        }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
            add_country_to_international_organization = scope:oe_ar_exarch_country
            international_organization_add_special_status = { type = special_status:oe_pillars_theme country = scope:oe_ar_exarch_country }
        }
        every_owned_location = {
            limit = { $region$ = yes NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system } }
            construct_building = { building_type = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system owner = scope:oe_ar_exarch_country cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
        }
        scope:oe_ar_exarch_country = {
            set_variable = oe_ar_exarchate
            set_variable = oe_theme_named
            set_variable = oe_theme_name_fixed  # keeps the exarchate's own name (gen_theme_names.py)
            set_variable = { name = oe_theme_distance value = 4 }
            change_country_name = $name$
            oe_ts_set_status = { status = 3 }  # 2026-11-18 territory rework: exarchate status (gen_territory_status.py)
            set_gold = 500
            add_manpower = 5
        }
        scope:oe_ar_seat = {
            while = { count = 5 create_sub_unit_with_owner = { type = oe_byz_theme_subject_soldier_I owner = scope:oe_ar_exarch_country } }
        }
    }
}

oe_ar_fire = {
    set_variable = oe_ar_done_$n$
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ar.$n$
}

# BYZ scope, monthly.
oe_ar_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = rome_reconquista_is_end NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ar_begun } }
        set_global_variable = oe_ar_begun
        set_variable = { name = oe_ar_months value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_ar_low value = 0 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ar.1
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain } oe_ar_tick = yes }
}

oe_ar_tick = {
    change_variable = { name = oe_ar_months add = 1 }
    change_variable = { name = oe_ar_strain add = oe_ar_strain_delta }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_ar_strain min = 0 max = 100 }
    # Strain tiers.
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ar_strained
    remove_country_modifier = oe_ar_overburdened
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_strain >= 60 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ar_overburdened years = -1 mode = replace } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_strain >= 30 } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ar_strained years = -1 mode = replace } }
    # Ten years under 30: the Pax Romana.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_strain < 30 } change_variable = { name = oe_ar_low add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_ar_low value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_low >= 120 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_done_12 } } oe_ar_fire = { n = 12 } }
    # Exarchates.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_months >= 6 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_done_2 } any_owned_location = { OR = { oe_hc_italy_location = yes oe_hc_africa_location = yes } NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_byz_theme_system } } } oe_ar_fire = { n = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_exarch_cd } any_subject = { has_variable = oe_ar_exarchate has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1 } }
        random = {
            chance = 10
            random_subject = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_exarchate has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1 } save_scope_as = oe_ar_ex }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ar_exarch value = scope:oe_ar_ex }
            set_variable = { name = oe_ar_exarch_cd years = 10 }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ar.3
        }
    }
    # The capital.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_path ?= 2 var:oe_ar_months >= 36 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_done_4 } } random = { chance = 2 oe_ar_fire = { n = 4 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_path ?= 3 var:oe_ar_months >= 240 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_done_5 } } oe_ar_fire = { n = 5 } }
    # Rome's old offices and the Church.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_months >= 24 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_done_6 } } oe_ar_fire = { n = 6 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_consuls NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_consul_cd } } set_variable = { name = oe_ar_consul_cd months = 12 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ar.13 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_months >= 36 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_done_7 } OR = { var:oe_ar_path ?= 2 var:oe_ar_path ?= 3 } } oe_ar_fire = { n = 7 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_months >= 12 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_done_8 } exists = international_organization:hre exists = international_organization:hre.leader_country international_organization:hre.leader_country = { NOT = { this = c:BYZ } } } oe_ar_fire = { n = 8 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_months >= 24 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_done_9 } location:rome = { owner = c:BYZ } location:constantinople = { owner = c:BYZ } location:alexandria = { owner = c:BYZ } location:antioch = { owner = c:BYZ } location:jerusalem = { owner = c:BYZ } } oe_ar_fire = { n = 9 } }
    # Crises.
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_strain >= 70 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_border_cd } } random = { chance = 4 set_variable = { name = oe_ar_border_cd months = 24 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ar.10 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_strain >= 60 NOT = { has_variable = oe_ar_plague_cd } } random = { chance = 3 set_variable = { name = oe_ar_plague_cd months = 36 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ar.11 } }
}
